meta.name: coderabbit-ci-integration
meta.description:
Configure CodeRabbit CI/CD integration with GitHub Actions and testing.
Use when setting up automated testing, configuring CI pipelines,
or integrating CodeRabbit tests into your build process.
Trigger with phrases like "coderabbit CI", "coderabbit GitHub Actions",
"coderabbit automated tests", "CI coderabbit".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 接入AI代码审查到CI流水线
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你在维护 GitHub 仓库并希望每次改动自动过一遍代码审查。
copy.tagline_en: Set up automated AI code review in your build pipeline
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you maintain a GitHub repo and want automated code review on every change.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会协助你配置 CodeRabbit 与 GitHub Actions 的 CI/CD 集成：创建自动化工作流文件、设置 API 密钥、编写集成测试，并给出发布和分支保护配置示例。
howto.when: 当你说出“coderabbit CI”“coderabbit GitHub Actions”等关键词，或要求设置自动化测试、配置 CI 管道、把 CodeRabbit 测试接入构建流程时触发。

say.text: 帮我配置 CodeRabbit 的 GitHub Actions 工作流
给这个仓库加上 CodeRabbit 自动测试
say.note: 会写入 npm 测试命令并配置 PR 检查。

say.text: 配置 CodeRabbit 在 CI 里的 API 密钥
say.note: 会执行 gh secret set 命令。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps configure CodeRabbit CI/CD with GitHub Actions: creates workflow files, sets API secrets, adds integration tests, and gives release and branch protection examples.
howto.when_en: Triggers on phrases like "coderabbit CI", "coderabbit GitHub Actions", etc., or when setting up automated testing, configuring CI pipelines, or integrating CodeRabbit tests into the build.

say_en.text: Set up a CodeRabbit GitHub Actions workflow for me
say_en.note: Creates the workflow file and prompts for the secret.

say_en.text: Add CodeRabbit automated tests to the project
say_en.note: Inserts npm test commands and configures PR checks.

say_en.text: Configure the CodeRabbit API secret for CI
say_en.note: Runs gh secret set for CODERABBIT_API_KEY.
